findings.title: Purge unlinks live SQLite WAL and shared-memory files
findings.evidence: Lines 178–190 classify every *.db-wal/*.db-shm as orphan and unlink it, without opening/checkpointing the database, checking live users, or applying CANONICAL_PROTECTED_DIRS.
findings.trigger: Invoke bundled script without --dry-run on a workspace containing a WAL-mode database with uncheckpointed committed writes.
findings.impact: Deletes recovery data and coordination files; subsequent database access can lose committed changes or encounter corruption. This is a callable bundled maintenance script, not evidence that it has been executed.

findings.title: Workspace purge resets unrelated live global sessions
findings.evidence: Lines 193–207 unconditionally target ~/.gemini/antigravity/conversation_summaries.db and UPDATE every RUNNING/not_fully_idle row to IDLE. No workspace filter or process-liveness check exists.
findings.trigger: Run purge for any workspace while another Antigravity conversation is running.
findings.impact: Global session bookkeeping is changed to idle despite live work, outside the selected workspace and without establishing that listeners are ghosts.

findings.title: Composite action inputs are interpolated into Bash source
findings.evidence: Lines 38–42 directly embed inputs in run text; ifc-path, pgou-path, format and strict become shell source. format is also unquoted in the redirect.
findings.trigger: A caller passes an input containing shell command substitution or quotes, for example an ifc-path containing $(...).
findings.impact: Commands execute with the workflow step privileges before cortex-guard receives arguments. Pass inputs through environment variables and validate output format.

findings.title: Container build pins compiler older than workspace manifests
findings.evidence: Builder uses rust:1.80-alpine and copies the entire workspace before cargo build at line 14. Workspace members include 00_ABZU_KERNEL/crates/strike-rs and crates/cadt_mediator, whose manifests declare edition = "2024"; Cargo.lock is version 4.
findings.impact: Cargo 1.80 cannot parse the 2024 workspace manifests, preventing the image from building. Static manifest incompatibility; build was not run.

findings.title: Replay campaign never establishes a successfully consumed authorization
findings.evidence: Replay authorization has resource_precondition_digest [0;32], then ignores the first execute_action result at line 166. src/executor_ipc.rs:167–172 computes the actual precondition using CanonicalHasher; src/executor.rs:1019 checks authorization against it before reservation. The replay match accepts any error at 193.
findings.impact: A precondition mismatch can reject both calls without exercising replay defense, yet the report records replay rejection as successful adversarial coverage.

findings.title: Crash report declares five tested points without interruption or recovery
findings.evidence: Cohort lines 326–355 synchronously quarantine, verify and destroy each file. No crash injection, restart, recovery operation or durable state reload occurs. Report nevertheless lists PREPARE/QUARANTINE/VERIFY/DISPATCH/COMMIT and SIGKILL_SIMULATED.
findings.trigger: Run the Gate 1 example and consume nemesis-crash-report.json.
findings.impact: PASS_ZERO_AMBIGUOUS_RECOVERIES can be emitted without testing any crash-recovery path, overstating persistence evidence.

findings.title: NEMESIS report passes when all secure-delete operations fail
findings.evidence: Match ignores all results except Committed and SecurityAbort (line 280). PASS_ZERO_TOCTOU_EXPLOITS is based only on unauth_count==0 at 301; no expected count of honest commits or attack rejections is asserted.
findings.trigger: secure_delete returns an infrastructure/error result for every attack and honest operation.
findings.impact: Harness reports security success for a completely nonfunctional deletion path; report cannot distinguish effective enforcement from universal errors.

findings.title: Stub exporter labels tautologies as verification of extracted claims
findings.evidence: generate_lean_code discards statement semantics: every extracted axiom becomes forall x, True (74), every theorem becomes True := by trivial (80–81). process_file injects this under Verificación Formal / Puente Isomorfo (107).
findings.trigger: Run exporter on a document containing a nontrivial or false theorem.
findings.impact: Generated Lean proves only True while the injected section presents a formal bridge to the document claim. No evidence of a production authorization consumer is asserted.

findings.title: Benchmark conclusions attribute simulator assumptions to external products
findings.evidence: Disseqt simulator explicitly sleeps 5ms per batch (57,77); C5 branch uses Python Lock and bytearray (130–146). Lines 235–238 present measured simulator ratio and assumed cost/queue arithmetic as statements about Disseqt, KLA/SupraWall and AgentAudit, without running their implementations.
findings.trigger: Run comparative demonstration and reuse printed conclusions.
findings.impact: Output cannot support product performance, evidence-preservation or fleet-freeze claims; it measures the chosen simulation and unrelated work rather than equivalent product behavior.

findings.title: Refusal is assigned zero KL without a probability distribution
findings.evidence: Line 54 assigns D_KL=0 to silence/empty output, while lines 48–50 define KL between normalized predictive distributions p and q. An empty output does not define q; zero mass on positive-p outcomes instead gives infinite KL.
findings.trigger: Apply the stated operational signatures to compare a refusing system with a calibrated predictor.
findings.impact: Mathematical audit can score absence of a predictive distribution as perfect calibration; abstention requires a separate coverage/selective-risk metric.

tool_limitations: No native codebase-memory graph tools exposed (ALL_TOOLS search returned empty); used targeted text reads and rg.
Audit is static only: no repository tests, builds, runtime, external APIs, or physical measurements executed.
Cross-file adjudication limited to workspace manifests, Cargo.lock, src/executor.rs and src/executor_ipc.rs.
